statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia
A 48-hour Holter monitoring study was ordered
The associated diagnoses are I48.91 and I47.1
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
The study is medically necessary to identify intermittent arrhythmias linked to symptoms
Continuous ambulatory cardiac rhythm monitoring is essential to guide further management
